title: Quirk governance corpus
summary: The machine-readable governance state of Quirk-Systems/.github: concept registry, portfolio registry, repository manifest, evidence receipts, JSON schemas, design-token source, and Copilot evaluation fixtures. One record is one JSON document.

collection.method: Authored and generated in-repository through reviewed pull requests; receipts are produced by scripts/create_evidence_receipt.py from tested Git subjects.

structure.record_unit: one JSON document (registry, manifest, receipt, schema, token file, or fixture)
structure.schema_reference: .quirk/schemas/ (receipts, decisions, manifests, portfolio, artifacts, dataset cards, design tokens)

intended_use: Fixtures for validator and schema tests in this repository
Dry evaluation of agent profiles and skills
Reference example of the Quirk dataset-card contract applied to real data
out_of_scope_use: Inferring repository purpose, ownership, or lifecycle from observed-unclassified entries
Treating any receipt or decision as authority for merge, canon, release, or deployment
known_limitations: Record count is pinned to the named commit and changes with every receipt
GitHub handles appear as authors and owners; no other personal data was observed in a full read on 2026-09-20
The evaluation fixtures are six synthetic cases, not a benchmark
